item.title: Solar and Lunar Eclipse
item.description:
On Wednesday the 12th we had perfect conditions to view the full Solar Eclipse, could not have asked for better.

Then on the 28th we got a partial Lunar Eclipse I think it was about 04:00 once again great conditions.
